title: Kumhrar Park, Patna - A Window to Ancient Pataliputra
content:
Kumhrar Park, Patna

Kumhrar Park, located in Patna, Bihar, is an archaeological site that unveils the glorious past of ancient Pataliputra, the capital of the mighty Mauryan Empire. This historical site gives visitors a glimpse into India’s earliest urban civilization, dating back more than 2,000 years. It’s a must-visit destination for history lovers and those curious about India’s ancient heritage.

History and Significance

The excavations at Kumhrar have revealed the remains of the Mauryan period (322-185 BCE), including the famous Eighty Pillared Hall, believed to be part of Emperor Ashoka’s assembly hall. Other discoveries include ancient ornaments, terracotta figures, and tools that highlight the advanced craftsmanship and urban planning of that era.
Kumhrar stands as a testimony to Pataliputra’s political, cultural, and architectural excellence.

What to See in Kumhrar Park

  • Eighty Pillared Hall - The main attraction, showcasing Mauryan architecture.
  • Arogya Vihar - An ancient medical center built by Buddhist monks.
  • Durakhi Devi Temple - A small shrine believed to be from the Gupta period.
  • Kumhrar Museum - Displays artifacts excavated from the site.

Best Time to Visit

The best time to visit Kumhrar Park is from October to March, when the weather is comfortable for exploring outdoor sites.

Entry Fee and Timings

  • Entry Fee: ₹20 (for Indian visitors)
  • Timings: 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM
  • Closed On: Monday

How to Reach

  • By Air: Nearest airport - Jay Prakash Narayan International Airport, 10 km away.
  • By Train: Patna Junction is about 6 km from the park.
  • By Road: Easily accessible via taxi, auto, or local bus from any part of Patna.

Nearby Places to visit

  • Golghar - Iconic dome-shaped granary offering city views. Read more..
  • Patna Museum- Showcases ancient artifacts from the Mauryan period. 
  • Takht Sri Patna Sahib - A major Sikh pilgrimage site. Read more..
  • Gandhi Maidan - A historical and cultural hub of Patna.

Why Visit Kumhrar Park

Kumhrar Park offers a peaceful and educational experience, taking you back to the era of Emperor Ashoka and ancient Pataliputra. It’s perfect for history enthusiasts, students, and travelers who wish to witness India’s glorious past firsthand.
